findings.checklist_item: - [ ] Add `tests/interfaces/conftest.py` to the `signing` shard's support list (or otherwise reconcile the per-shard attribution), since signing's `tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_signature.py` loads `tests/interfaces/conftest.py` as an ancestor and there is no `tests/interfaces/lifecycle/conftest.py`.
evidence: tests/interfaces/conftest.py exists (read confirms it); directory listing of tests/interfaces/lifecycle/ shows NO conftest.py, and grep for 'interfaces/lifecycle/conftest' returned (no matches), so pytest loads tests/interfaces/conftest.py as the ancestor for test_signature.py

Plan text: 'Put tests/unit/conftest.py in the per-shard support lists for signing, compact-policy, and push-policy only' and 'Put tests/interfaces/conftest.py in the per-shard support lists for reducer-processors, gates, next-batch, and validate only' — signing is omitted from the interfaces conftest owners
findings.finding: The plan's per-shard conftest attribution contradicts the pytest upward-ancestry premise it relies on: the `signing` shard includes `tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_signature.py`, whose loaded ancestor conftest is `tests/interfaces/conftest.py` (there is no `tests/interfaces/lifecycle/conftest.py`), but the plan assigns `tests/interfaces/conftest.py` to 'reducer-processors, gates, next-batch, and validate only' and gives signing only `tests/unit/conftest.py`.
findings.location: Plan section 'Plan', bullets 2-3; Acceptance Criteria 'Each true ancestor conftest change selects exactly its dependent mutation shards'
scenarios: The deterministic derived-ancestor contract (Plan step 5) computes signing's ancestor closure as {tests/conftest.py, tests/unit/conftest.py, tests/interfaces/conftest.py} but the manifest support list lacks tests/interfaces/conftest.py, so the equality assertion fails at contract-authoring time.

If the contract is instead coded to accept the plan's stated lists, a future change to tests/interfaces/conftest.py selects reducer-processors/gates/next-batch/validate but NOT signing — silently dropping signing mutation coverage for a fixture it actually loads.
findings.suggested_fix: Amend the plan's third bullet so `tests/interfaces/conftest.py` owners are 'signing, reducer-processors, gates, next-batch, and validate' (all shards with any test under tests/interfaces/), and confirm the derived-ancestor contract expands signing's lifecycle test path to that ancestor.
